description: This file contains Swift unit tests for the ExecApprovalsStore functionality, particularly focusing on its file handling, allowlist management, and state directory permissions.

methods.name: withTempStateDir
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory for testing, sets environment variable, executes a body closure, and cleans up.

methods.name: `ensure file skips rewrite when unchanged`
methods.description: Tests that the file identity remains the same if the file hasn't changed.

methods.name: `update allowlist reports rejected basename pattern`
methods.description: Verifies that invalid allowlist patterns are rejected correctly.

methods.name: `update allowlist migrates legacy pattern from resolved path`
methods.description: Checks that legacy patterns are correctly migrated to full paths.

methods.name: `ensure file hardens state directory permissions`
methods.description: Ensures that the state directory permissions are set securely (700).

methods.name: fileIdentity
methods.description: Retrieves a file's system-specific identifier for change detection.
